notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped region-qualified interaction delivery through time-constrained grants, timestamp/order/transportation/producer metadata, conveyed source-region designators, request retraction and terminal retraction behavior, and independent time, region, federation, and connection cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction send, retraction, time-management, regional subscription, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction(time) and requestRetraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction declarations
